caption:
Momo pushes trolleys, lifts bags into lockers and stands for hours. After every landing, her back and shoulders are done.

Lifting a heavy bag straight overhead with just your arms can load up your back and shoulders. Using your trunk and lifting in stages, via chest height, may share the load.

Hybi's tip: 8 slow bridges, 8 wall arm slides and 10 calf raises, even in a layover hotel. Keep trolleys close and push with your legs.

Tingling in your arm or hand, or pain at night, are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physio-led clinical Pilates team can help. Book online via the link in bio ✈️
